Held directly in Batak Land, this event was designed as a homecoming stage for the Batak diaspora spread across various cities in Indonesia and abroad. Through stories, music and the atmosphere of their hometown, Tona Sian Huta becomes a nostalgic bridge that connects migrants with their cultural roots. More than just a show, Tona Sian Huta is expected to become a cultural magnet that encourages Batak migrants to return to visit Batak Land—bringing their family, friends and community. Thus, this event not only celebrates Batak cultural identity, but also opens up great opportunities for the development of cultural tourism in Batak Land, attracting tourists from within and outside the country to experience firsthand the richness of Batak traditions.

description: Petrick Kluivert Piano Recital presents an intimate evening of classical piano, featuring works by R. Schumann, J. Brahms, F. Chopin, and S. Rachmaninoff. This recital explores the many shades of becoming: innocence, longing, inner conflict, tenderness, and emotional maturity. Through Schumann’s Abegg Variations, Brahms’ Klavierstücke Op. 76, Chopin’s Polonaise-Fantaisie Op. 61, and Rachmaninoff’s Piano Sonata Op. 36 No. 2, Petrick invites the audience into a musical journey shaped by lyricism, virtuosity, and deep personal reflection. Born in the 90's, Petrick began studying piano at the age of 9. He trained under Imelda and Teo Minaroy before continuing his studies at Yayasan Pendidikan Musik Jakarta, including the Pre-Conservatory Program, under the guidance of renowned Indonesian pianists Gita Bayuratri, Levi Gunardi, and Aisha Sudiarso Pletscher. He later continued private studies with Iswargia Renardi Sudarno, acclaimed Indonesian pedagogue, conductor, and Director of Jakarta Conservatory of Music. During his musical journey, Petrick received several recognitions, including the YPM Young Artist Award in 2015 and 2017, The Most Outstanding Performance Award from 2013 to 2015, 1st Prize at Bandung National Piano Competition, Finalist at Jakarta Conservatory of Music Boston Piano Competition, and Grand Finalist at Indonesia Steinway Youth Piano Competition. He has also participated in masterclasses with distinguished musicians, including German pianist and pedagogue Josef Anton Scherrer. Join Petrick for an evening of powerful, poetic, and deeply expressive piano music at Balai Recital Kertanegara.

title: Nitya Nartana
description: Nitya Nartana The Dance Lives On Nitya Nartana is a stage where the pulse of life meets the movement of dance, where tradition continues to beat through dancing bodies. Each dance comes from different cultural roots, but is united in one breath: the breath of life that continues to flow through movements that are maintained and inherited. We are studio members who come from various backgrounds. We are not professional dancers, but rather learners who grow through regular practice, repetition, and a willingness to respect the process. What appears on stage is the result of joint work, not perfection, but sincerity. Nitya means Immortal, and Nartana means Dance. As long as the heart continues to move, the dance will always live, guarded by those who are willing to care for it, and passed on to those who are willing to carry it on. Nitya Nartana is an invitation to witness that dance never really stops. It lives in every exercise, every repetition, every time the body chooses to return to movement. A shared space for traditions to be present closely and relevantly. An invitation to listen, feel and celebrate the richness of Indonesian dance, as long as the pulse is still there, the dance will continue to live. Thank you for being part of our journey.

title: Sendratari Wanara Alas Roban 2026
description:
WANARA SENDRATARY ALAS ROBAN
Guardian of the Forest, Guardian of Civilization (A Grand Cultural Spectacle of Batang)
One night. One legend. One cultural experience that drives many stories. There are shows that end when the stage lights go out. But Wanara Alas Roban wanted to leave something longer than that. A cultural experience that brings together art, tourism, community, MSMEs, creativity and the local economy in one celebration. The journey started in the afternoon. Come early and enjoy the Sunset Cultural Experience enjoying the Batang twilight, art performances, ethnic music, community activities, culinary delights, creative products, as well as various works of local MSMEs. Don't rush home. Because when the sun sets, the journey actually enters the next stage.
FROM DUSK TO NIGHT
Enjoy the festival atmosphere. Discover local culinary delights. Hunt for creative and craft products. Meet the community. Take photos. Share stories. Torch party. Flashmob. Content Competition. And support the creative economy actors who take part in bringing this celebration to life. Because every food you buy, every local product you choose, and every creator's work that you appreciate is part of an economic chain that moves with a cultural event. This is where culture is not only performed. Culture creates opportunities.
WHEN NIGHT COMES, WANARA ENTERES THE STAGE
When light begins to fill the performance space, the atmosphere changes. Music echoes. Torch barricades and fire dancing. The dancers move. Laser shot. The legend of Alas Roban comes to life. Wanara Alas Roban brings the story of the Guardian of the Forest, the Guardian of Civilization through dance, music, visuals, light and colossal performances. A story about courage, loyalty, wisdom, and man's relationship with nature. And all of them meet the face of Batang today—an area that continues to grow, move, and look to the future.
YOUR ONE TICKET, MANY IMPACT FOR YOUR EARTH
When you buy Wanara Alas Roban tickets, you are not just buying the experience of watching a show. You become part of a larger ecosystem. Your ticket lights up the stage. The stage brings the artists to life. Artists drive creative production. Festivals bring visitors. Visitors drive culinary, MSMEs, crafts, transportation, tourism and various local businesses. From there, the economy moves back to society. This is the multiplier effect of a cultural event.
One show can open up space for many creatives to grow together. The Wanara Alas Roban concept is designed so that the event becomes a driver of the regional creative economy ecosystem, rather than stopping as a performance on stage.
ADI, WHAT DID YOU ACTUALLY BUY?
Not just a ticket. You buy a twilight and a night full of experiences. You get the opportunity to:
ENJOY THE DUSK
Feel the atmosphere of Batang before night falls.
EXPLORE THE FESTIVAL
Discover culinary delights, MSMEs, crafts, creative products and local communities.
WITNESS THE SHOW
Enter the world of Wanara Alas Roban through a colossal performance.
FEEL THE PEAK OF THE NIGHT
Watch the Wanara Alas Roban Grand Parade and the light festival that concludes the trip.
BRINGING THE STORY HOME
An experience that can be remembered, photographed, shared and retold. And the most important thing is that you help make the culture move.
FROM THE STAGE TO THE COMMUNITY
Wanara Alas Roban believes that cultural performances should not stop for two or three hours. He can create a work space. Opening opportunities for artists. Mobilizing MSMEs. Bringing the community to life. Encourage tourist visits. Raising local products. And bring together people with new creativity. Because one cultural event can benefit many surrounding sectors from culinary and crafts to tourism, hotels, transportation, content and fashion.
AND WHEN THE STAGE LIGHTS GO OUT.
Maybe the show is over. But stories don't. There are artists who come home with experience. There are MSMEs that bring in sales proceeds. There are creators who bring content. There are tourists who bring memories. There are communities that carry pride. And there are those of you who come home with stories about a night when culture, creativity and the future of Batang met on one stage.
WANARA ALAS ROBAN FOREST GUARD, GUARDIAN OF CIVILIZATION
Come as a spectator. Moving with the creative economy. Coming home as part of the story. Buy your ticket. Present your experience. And help revive Batang's culture and creativity.

It's not just about romantic relationships, but also about relationships with family, friends, and yourself. Because the way we love, build relationships, deal with loss, understand attachment, set boundaries, and build self-worth are closely related to mental health. Together with Fabiola Priscila, S.Psi., M.Psi., Psychologist, C.PHt. , Dr. Hans Christian, Sp.KJ, dr. Ashwin Kandouw, Sp.KJ, and Zoya Amirin, M.Psi., FIAS, participants will be invited to explore various perspectives on love, relationships and mental health. This journey will also be accompanied by special performances from Isyana Sarasvati, MAKO•, and TADI, who will present an emotional experience through music. A safe space to pause, understand yourself, share stories, and learn to build healthier relationships with others and with yourself.

title: Omah Jati Music Experience
description: Omah Jati Music Experience Hidden within the tranquil teak forest of Anyer, Omah Jati Music Experience invites you to step into a different kind of concert. Set inside Omah Jati Resort , the stage sits among towering teak trees, creating a rare atmosphere where music and nature exist in perfect harmony. As the night unfolds, the forest becomes the backdrop for an intimate live music experience designed for those who appreciate something more personal than a typical festival. With a carefully curated setting and a limited number of guests, every moment feels closer, warmer, and more connected. This is not just a concert. It’s a destination. Day : Saturday, 22 August 2026 Time : 01.00 PM - 22.45 AM Location : Omah Jati Anyer, Bandulu Anyer, Serang The Experience Imagine an evening surrounded by nature, where great music flows effortlessly through the forest air. Omah Jati Music Experience was created to bring people together through music in a setting that feels relaxed, intimate, and unforgettable. Away from crowded venues and oversized stages, this experience focuses on what matters most the music, the atmosphere, and the people sharing the moment. Since its first edition, the event has been successfully held three times and continues to grow as one of the most unique music gatherings in Anyer. Wijaya80 To help enrich Indonesia’s musical repertoire, Ardhito Pramono (vocals/keytar), Erikson Jayanto (keyboard-synth), and Hezky Joe (vocals/guitar) came together to form the trio Wijaya80. The group is committed to bringing the glory of ’80s music back to today’s listeners. Blending classic-toned lyrics with creative pop arrangements inspired by the ’80s era, Wijaya80 invites listeners to travel through a musical corridor of time across six songs in their debut album, Perjumpaan . Adhitia Sofyan Adhitia Sofyan is an indie singer-songwriter from Jakarta. He started from recording his mellow acoustic-folk tunes in his bedroom to performing in countries like Singapore in Japan. White Shoes & The Couples Company White Shoes & The Couples Company (WSATCC) is an Indonesian Pop Sextet from Jakarta who perform Indonesiana (Indonesian Pop music). The band consisted of 6 members and was formed in 2002 on the campus of the Jakarta Arts Institute. Their music is greatly inspired by old Indonesia films soundtracks from the 70s and the acoustic spirit of Jazz musicians from the 30s – along with absorbing the rhythmical influence of retro disco as well as classical music arrangements, paying homage to the golden age of Indonesian Pop music during the 50s and the 70s, and particularly deriving inspiration from works by notable names in the history of Indonesian music. Why You Should Be Here A setting you won’t find anywhere else A forest stage surrounded by nature A curated music experience Artists selected for a night that flows naturally from one performance to the next A truly intimate atmosphere Only 250 guests will share this experience Getting to Omah Jati Drive and Park For guests bringing their own vehicle, parking is available at the designated area at Tukik Beach, just a short distance from Omah Jati. From there, you can continue your journey by shuttle to the venue. Click here to view the location on Google Maps. Shuttle Service For guests traveling from Jakarta, a shuttle service is provided to ensure a convenient and seamless journey to the venue. Sit back and enjoy a comfortable round-trip ride from the city to Omah Jati Anyer and back. The shuttle will depart from Nirmana Falatehan at 9 AM, bringing you directly to the venue, and will return to the same point after the event concludes. Route Nirmana Falatehan → Omah Jati Anyer → Nirmana Falatehan
